description: A 10-storey hotel 45 by 18 m: a lobby on the ground floor with 120 guests, 60 guests on each upper floor in rooms off a central corridor, stairs at both ends, main entrance on the south and a service exit on the north.

spec.name: Hotel
assumptions: Main entrance 2.4 m wide, service exit 1.2 m wide.
Stairs 1.2 m wide at both ends.
Each upper floor has 30 guest rooms off a central corridor.
Lobby on ground floor, 60 guests per upper floor.
